heading: Hidden Layers | TTC Edition June 2023
subheading: A fourth meeting in Sweden brings wide-ranging progress
excerpt: U.S. and EU officials gathered May 30-31 for the fourth ministerial meeting of the Trade and Technology Council (TTC) in Luleå, Sweden. The meeting focused on transatlantic cooperation on emerging technologies, particularly artificial intelligence (AI) and 6G, export controls and investment screenings. The meeting made notable progress in five areas.
